10 October 2024, full operations expected H1 2026.

Despite extensive satellite probing along the W Mississippi Street corridor
and across the CenterPoint Intermodal Center (east, west, south of the existing
CJ LC1 at 21705 W Mississippi St), **no distinct construction site or new

fieldNotes.location: EXACT BUILDING NOT POSITIVELY IDENTIFIED. Address confirmed via CJ Logistics' own open-space page: 21012 W. Mississippi Street, Elwood, IL (Elwood 2 / NEXUS). This is a brand-new build-to-suit (ARCO/Murray, groundbreaking 10 Oct 2024, full ops H1 2026); current Maxar imagery of the CenterPoint corridor shows only established buildings - no distinct bare-earth construction pad could be matched to 21012 W Mississippi St, and the new building cannot be told apart from the dozens of similar CenterPoint warehouses. fieldNotes.railServed: Marketed as adjacent to BNSF and Union Pacific rail lines; CenterPoint Intermodal Center is rail-served. Whether a spur enters the building parcel is unverified.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: CenterPoint Intermodal Center, Elwood - edge-of-town industrial park surrounded by farmland; rural setting.
